content.text: Berrie is transformed into fashionable clothes in a hotel, then lunches in the café with her mother and Wayland before meeting his father. They move to the parlor, where Norcross questions Berrie privately and ultimately proposes traveling by private car to California and considering a nearby ranch. The text then shifts to Leonardo’s principles of aerial perspective and painting. Harry leaves stable work for Wake & Wade’s dry-goods store, boards with the Flints, and travels to Rockville to visit ill Julia. His savings are stolen; later Ben Smart attacks him near a burying ground, and Harry recovers at home. After exposing Edward’s theft, Harry is jailed briefly, reunited with his father, and eventually marries Julia. Another narrative follows the Dashahed Zouaves: boys camp at Camp McClellan, drill, hold a grand review on the lawn, receive a flag at the piazza, and prepare to leave camp.
